title: On the irrationality of cubic fourfolds
summary: Following the work of Katzarkov--Kontsevich--Pantev--Yu concerning the irrationality of the very general complex cubic fourfold, we prove the following: for every rational smooth complex cubic fourfold, the primitive cohomology is isomorphic as a Hodge structure to the (twisted) middle cohomology of a projective K3 surface.
